name: PresaleBEP20 public set(address) withdrawal redirect
summary: PresaleBEP20.set(address) is public and deposit() enforces its 100 BNB cap only per msg.sender while forwarding deposits straight to the mutable withdrawAddress, so the attacker redirected withdrawals to itself and recycled a 100 WBNB flash loan through 70 fresh depositors.
